hero.eyebrow: A garden hideaway near downtown Aiken
hero.title: Cozy, tranquil, and *a short walk to town*
hero.lede: Two acres of gardens, exquisitely decorated rooms and a breakfast cooked every morning by a local chef, within walking distance of downtown Aiken's restaurants and shops.

sections.title: Breakfast by *Bruce Shipman*
body: Bruce Shipman, a local chef and the proprietor, cooks breakfast every morning: fresh eggs, breakfast meats and a variety of seasonal fruits, with juice, cereal and freshly brewed coffee on hand.

sections.title: Planning a visit to Aiken?
sections.text: Call to ask about dates and rooms.

before: No website of its own: a search leads to a social page or a directory listing
Hours, address and what you offer are spread across other people's sites
The first thing a new customer sees is not something the business controls
after: A site the business owns, at its own address
Hours, phone, address and map in one obvious place
One-tap call and directions on a phone
A proper preview when the link is shared by text or on Facebook
Room to add a menu, photos and news as the owner supplies them
